labels.label: Bring in a customer sheet Excel (.xlsx) or CSV. The first row must hold the column names. The file is read on this phone
Try it with a sample sheet
Name Needed. Who to ask for.
Phone Needed. Repeated numbers are left out.
Phone 2 Optional. A second number to try, such as an office line.
Email Optional. Used for email follow-ups.
Company Optional. Shown under the name.
Amount Optional. Deal value, or the amount owed.
Due date Optional. Collections only: gives days overdue.
